order: [jar] NOTHING TO ORDER, and this is the honest headline: yungsapi registers zero items, zero blocks and zero structures. It is a pure library.
structures: [jar] YUNG's Api itself contributes NO structures. The structures people mean when they say 'YUNG's' live in separate mods - Better Dungeons, Better Strongholds, Better Mineshafts, Better Desert Temples, Better Ocean Monuments, Better Witch Huts, Better Nether Fortresses, Better Jungle Temples, Better End Island - and NONE of those are installed in CREATE FEMBY either.
A structure-visit quest cannot be written against yungsapi. If the pack wants YUNG content, the Better* mods have to be added first; the api on its own changes nothing a player can see.
traps: Do not let a jar scan of yungsapi produce quest ids. There are none to produce.
